en-US.name: Contextify
en-US.subtitle: AI History, Searchable + Cloud Sync
en-US.promotional_text: NEW: Contextify Cloud. Push your AI conversation history to the cloud and search it from any device. 14-day free trial.
en-US.description:
Contextify keeps a searchable record of every Claude Code and Codex conversation you have.

CONTEXTIFY CLOUD

Push your conversation database to the cloud and search it from any device. Choose exactly which projects sync with per-project controls. Team management with seat-based billing. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

SEARCH EVERYTHING

Search across every conversation you've ever had. Find that one command, that specific fix, or that brilliant solution from weeks ago in seconds. Porter stemming, git-anchored search, and smart query handling make finding things fast.

REAL-TIME MONITORING

Watch sessions unfold in real-time. Each message is summarized using Apple Intelligence so you can skim what happened while you were away, or follow along as your AI works.

FEATURES

• Contextify Cloud with cross-device sync and team management
• Real-time timeline of Claude Code and Codex sessions
• AI-powered summaries generated on-device via Apple Intelligence
• Menu bar mode for background monitoring
• Always-on-top window to watch sessions while you work
• Powerful search: full-text in-app and semantic search via Total Recall CLI
• Companion CLI for macOS and Linux
• Launch at Login support
• Automatic project organization
• Custom database locations (Dropbox, iCloud Drive)

TOTAL RECALL - SEMANTIC SEARCH

Install via Settings > CLI. Ask your AI to search your conversation history:

"Use total recall to find where we decided to use Redis instead of Postgres for the session cache."

"Use total recall to find when I was most frustrated and what my greatest insights were over the past quarter."

PRIVACY

Local-first by default. All AI summaries are generated on-device using Apple Intelligence. Cloud sync is entirely opt-in, with per-project controls so you decide what leaves your machine.

REQUIREMENTS

• macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later
• macOS 26+ for AI summaries (Lite Mode on macOS 15)
• Claude Code or Codex CLI installed
en-US.release_notes:
What's New in v1.5.0

Contextify Cloud
• Push your conversation database to the cloud and search it from any device
• Per-project sync controls let you choose exactly what gets synced
• Progress tracking with ETA estimation during sync
• Team management with seat-based billing
• 14-day free trial, no credit card required

Search Quality
• Porter stemming for better natural-language matching ("deploy" finds "deployed", "deployment")
• Git-anchored search: find conversations by the files they touched
• Better handling of hyphens, parentheses, and unbalanced quotes

CLI Improvements
• Time filtering with --hours, --since, --until
• Fuzzy project name suggestions on typo
• Search scope summary showing entry, project, and device counts
• Cloud push, pull, and status commands

New Features
• Menu bar mode with background utility operation
• Launch at Login support
• Transcript tagging for excluding benchmarks from search
• Proof-of-concept Gemini CLI and OpenCode transcript support

Reliability
• Automatic retry on transient server errors
• Large query chunking to stay under SQLite limits
• Graceful deferral when ingest is in progress

review_information.notes:
Hello. Thank you for reviewing my app.

SAMPLE DATA:
https://contextify.sh/review-4a125b1d/sample-data.zip

DEMO VIDEO:
https://contextify.sh/review-4a125b1d/demo-video.mp4

SETUP INSTRUCTIONS (also in README.txt inside the archive):
1. Download and extract sample-data.zip
2. Create directories (needed if Claude Code/Codex not installed):
   mkdir -p ~/.claude/projects
   mkdir -p ~/.codex/sessions
3. Copy the claude/ folder contents to ~/.claude/projects/
4. Copy the codex/ folder contents to ~/.codex/sessions/
5. Launch Contextify
6. Grant permission when prompted for ~/.claude/ access
7. App will detect sample projects (taskflow, weatherly, recipebox)
8. Timeline displays conversations, LLM summaries generate automatically

FEATURES TO TEST:
- Timeline view - shows conversation history with timestamps
- LLM summaries - auto-generated for each conversation
- Quick Search (Cmd+F) - filter current project
- Deep Search (Cmd+Shift+F) - search across all projects
- Project switching - click tabs to switch between projects

The sample data contains synthetic Claude Code and Codex CLI transcript files demonstrating all app features.

app_privacy.data_usage: All data is stored locally by default. Users who opt in to Contextify Cloud can sync their conversation database to cloud.contextify.sh for cross-device search. Cloud sync is per-project and can be disabled at any time. AI summaries are always generated on-device via Apple Intelligence.
